# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b9 — Device-first room and home settings

**Opt-in beta 9 — Home Assistant 2026.10+**. Stable v0.5.1 remains
unchanged. All features and the controller safety corrections in beta 8
are preserved. The integration's domain is still `air_quality_advisor` and
existing configuration entries and original entity IDs are not migrated.

## Home device: complete home data and shared settings

The existing Home Environment Manager recommendation sensor is retained
as the central dashboard snapshot, now inside an explicit parent Home
device. Its attributes expose environmental readings, weather and warning
sources, occupancy configuration, global thresholds, recommendation details,
and room diagnostics. Existing Lovelace cards and automations do not need
to change their entity IDs.

The parent device gains native Home Assistant controls for **all 22 global
thresholds**, announcement repeat minutes, notifications, speech, AI rewrite,
Announcement Hub selection and language. A home-wide change affects every
configured room, with validation and no independent actuation.

## Area devices: PID and comfort policy editing

Configured area devices retain their single environment overview (raw
sensor sources and derived decisions as attributes). A calculated mold
surface RH sensor is still optional. Existing native thermostat, humidity,
fan, CO2 and temperature controls are never duplicated.

Rooms with an enabled supervisor PID gain device configuration numbers:
the **PID room target**, **Kp / Ki / Kd**, sample interval, output offset,
allowed setpoint range and per-cycle change limits. Its gain source
selector supports **fixed defaults** and **manual**. The default gains
are Kp=22, Ki=0.25, Kd=0 and a 300-second sampling interval. These are
existing conservative fixed defaults, **not automatic system
identification or an auto-tune routine**. Editing gains changes the
source to Manual; choosing Defaults restores the configured baseline.
Bad ranges, conflicting limits and changes during an in-flight PID
write are rejected rather than commanding arbitrary HVAC hardware.

Rooms with climate profiles expose their home, unoccupied, away and sleep
heat/cool policy temperatures and manual/automatic profile choice. Real
equipment modes and currently active setpoints still belong to their own
Home Assistant entities, and safety/occupancy interlocks remain active.

The options menu no longer duplicates home-wide threshold and announcement
toggles or PID tuning. Device assignments, commissioning, outdoor data
providers, occupancy entity pickers, calibration and other hardware inputs
remain in the guided Configure menu where cross-field checks are required.

## Navigation and localization

The Home Environment Manager dashboard now includes a compact settings
icon on **every room**, including climate-only rooms, that opens the actual
Home Assistant area-device detail view. A similar header icon opens the
parent home device. Links are resolved from the Home Assistant device
registry using the integration's stable identifiers, not guessed area
names or fabricated URLs. The new controls are added to all 38 supplied
languages; principal card labels include Greek, German, English, French
and Spanish.

## Safety, compatibility, installation

No window, relay, fan or compressor permission is granted by introducing
configuration entities. Physical devices must still be explicitly
selected and independently commissioned. Manual PID changes only adjust
bounded supervisor setpoints and cannot restart paused equipment. Source
unavailability and stale readings continue to fail closed.

All automated tests on Python 3.13 and 3.14, translation generation,
frontend card tests, Hassfest and HACS validation must pass before this
branch can publish its immutable prerelease tag and signed-by-checksum
manual installation ZIP. Testing cannot replace physical HVAC
commissioning or certify electrical protection.

Back up your Home Assistant configuration. Install with HACS using
**Redownload → Show beta versions → v0.6.0b9**, then restart Home
Assistant. Keep the existing integration entry; use **Configure**
to edit hardware assignments and source-specific selectors. If your
HACS UI cannot select prereleases, use the attached manual installation
ZIP and its SHA-256 checksum.
